source.title: Best Practices for Scientific Computing
source.authors: Wilson G, Aruliah DA, Brown CT, Chue Hong NP, Davis M, Guy RT, et al.

license.evidence: The article copyright statement links directly to CC BY 4.0 and allows use, distribution and reproduction with author and source credit. The original PDF page 1 also contains its attribution license statement.

input_preparation.changes: Rendered the entire original page at 200 DPI. No cropping, retouching, text substitution, or rearrangement. Original PDF is unmodified.

reference_text.limitations: Native PDF text extraction may have non-visual reading order, ligatures, hyphenation and line-break differences.

verification.visual_review: Entire rendered page inspected; public research prose and numbered summary are legible. No local application UI or private customer content included.
verification.pdf_metadata_review: Publisher title, timestamps and production tools only; no local Windows paths or email addresses in XMP; no embedded attachments; pdfinfo reports no JavaScript or forms.
verification.png_metadata_review: RGB with DPI metadata only; no alpha, EXIF, author or file-path metadata.
